title: Stablecoin-settled account
description: A dollar balance settled in USDC by the provider: add from a bank, hold, cash out.
goal_template: A dollar balance app settled in USDC by the licensed provider. Customers add US dollars from their bank account, keep a dollar balance and cash it back out to their bank account. Every screen shows dollars only, never crypto. Show the amount and the fee before the customer accepts each one.

screens.title: Balance
screens.purpose: The dollar balance and recent activity, in dollars only, from the lifecycle events api/ receives on Mynt's webhook.

screens.title: Sign up
screens.purpose: Onboarding: the product's journey, with its consents, required documents and the provider's hosted identity checks.

screens.title: Add money
screens.purpose: Add dollars from the customer's bank account: the amount and fee shown first, then the provider's hosted flow.

screens.title: Cash out
screens.purpose: Cash the balance out to the customer's bank account: the amount and fee shown first, then the provider's hosted flow.

flows.title: Add money
steps: read the offer (offers) for the fee and the limits
show the amount and the fee in dollars before the customer accepts
start the provider's hosted flow (startAction); the provider settles it, the app never moves money itself
api/ records the outcome from Mynt's webhook (verifyWebhook)

flows.title: Cash out
steps: show the amount and the fee in dollars
start the provider's hosted cash-out flow (startAction)
show its status until the webhook says it settled
